summary: Israel conducted overnight airstrikes in southern Lebanon targeting Hezbollah infrastructure in Nabatieh and Ansar, killing a Radwan Force battalion commander and other militants. The IRGC launched at least three missiles toward the Strait of Hormuz while the US prepares expanded economic and maritime pressure on Iran. In Gaza, a Givati Brigade tank struck a Hamas IED with no casualties, and paratroopers eliminated two militants crossing the yellow line.

sections.executive_summary: Israel conducted overnight airstrikes in southern Lebanon targeting Hezbollah infrastructure in Nabatieh and Ansar, killing a Radwan Force battalion commander and other militants. The IRGC launched at least three missiles toward the Strait of Hormuz while the US prepares expanded economic and maritime pressure on Iran. In Gaza, a Givati Brigade tank struck a Hamas IED with no casualties, and paratroopers eliminated two militants crossing the yellow line.

points: Tehran's District 4 suffered 298 strikes during the 40-day war, affecting neighborhoods including Tehranpars, Hakimiyeh, Pasdaran, Lavizan, Majidiyeh, Shemiran-e-No, Haravi, Narmak-e-Shomali, and Shamsabad. (Source: @kianmeli1/90876)
Iran unveiled a new submarine developed during the war, signaling continued domestic military innovation despite conflict pressures. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94150)

Three Iranian Air Force pilots flying Su-24s that crashed in March were captured alive by Qatari forces and have been detained for approximately six months without consular access. (Source: @VahidOnline/77878)

Qatar's Foreign Ministry denied holding the pilots alive, stating search teams found remains of one pilot and contacted Iran to coordinate handover; Tehran has not yet responded. (Source: @N12chat/222075)
The IRGC launched at least three missiles toward the Strait of Hormuz, demonstrating willingness to threaten critical maritime chokepoints. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/79346)

Trump asserted Iranian leadership is decimated, radar systems destroyed, and missile production capacity reduced by 82%, claiming only a fraction of previous drone and missile capabilities remain. (Source: @VahidOnline/77874)

Iran's Foreign Minister Araghchi denied ongoing negotiations with the US, confirmed Qatar and Pakistan are relaying messages, and stated Iran and Oman are determining new maritime routes for shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @VahidOnline/77874)

IDF confirmed one officer and two soldiers seriously wounded by an explosive drone in southern Lebanon overnight; one soldier's condition later improved to moderate. (Source: @inon_yttach/9860, @yediotnews25/133955)
Givati Brigade tank struck a Hamas IED in southern Gaza along the yellow line during operational activity; no Israeli casualties reported. (Source: @New_security8200/203320)
Paratroopers identified and eliminated two militants who crossed the yellow line in Gaza attempting to sabotage IDF equipment, calling it a ceasefire violation. (Source: @New_security8200/203320)

IDF struck a Hezbollah headquarters in Ansar, killing Radwan Force battalion commander Ali Samir Al-Haj Hassan and several other militants; Hassan's family was present and reportedly harmed but not targeted. (Source: @almogboker78/17970)
IDF attacked Hezbollah infrastructure in Nabatieh and Ansar in response to Hezbollah action against Israeli forces in the Ali Tahar ridge within the security zone. (Source: @idf_telegram/24903)

Upper Galilee Regional Council warned residents of artillery shelling, airstrikes, and explosions overnight due to IDF activity in Lebanon; no changes to civilian guidelines. (Source: @manniefabian/58976)
Northern residents were notified of extensive IDF attacks planned in southern Lebanon overnight with expected explosions along the border. (Source: @New_security8200/203323)
A Givati Brigade tank operating in southern Gaza along the yellow line struck a Hamas IED; no Israeli casualties were reported. (Source: @New_security8200/203320)
Paratroopers detected two militants crossing the yellow line in Gaza attempting to tamper with IDF weapons systems; forces engaged and eliminated both militants. (Source: @New_security8200/203320)
Enemy media reported a tank attacked in the Gaza Strip due to a Hamas mine, confirming the IED incident. (Source: @naya_foriraq/87859)
IDF characterized the militant crossing and IED attack as violations of the ceasefire agreement and vowed to continue removing immediate threats. (Source: @New_security8200/203320)
Israeli airstrikes targeted Deir al-Zahrani in southern Lebanon, hitting a residential house in the Al-Ras neighborhood and a motorcycle simultaneously. (Source: @kianmeli1/90878)
Lebanese media reported casualties from the strike on a building in Deir al-Zahrani. (Source: @New_security8200/203315)
Artillery shelling was reported on Ali al-Tahir in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/36782)
An air strike hit Al-Qantara in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/36776)
Warplanes were observed flying over southern Lebanon at maximum alert levels. (Source: @redlinkleb/36765)

Iran attacked the US naval base in Bahrain early in the war, destroying large parts including a central logistics hub, forcing the US Navy to relocate its logistics center to Diego Garcia over 3,500 km away. (Source: @asafroz/52480)
The IRGC fired at least three missiles toward the Strait of Hormuz, directly threatening Gulf maritime security. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/79346)
Trump declared intent to bring the Strait of Hormuz under US control, escalating rhetoric over the strategic waterway. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/79355)
Iran and Oman are determining new maritime routes for shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, with naval forces from both countries participating. (Source: @VahidOnline/77874)

The UAE reports the US is preparing a significant escalation of economic and maritime pressure on Iran, targeting financial networks and money exchangers suspected of funding the IRGC. (Source: @pkpoi/143611)
An Iranian MP warned the US president to worry about his own security rather than bluffing about the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @presstv/202923)
PressTV claims growing public awareness in Persian Gulf Arab states will eventually lead to popular uprisings against their governments. (Source: @presstv/202932)

sections.threat_assessment: The simultaneous escalation on multiple fronts — Israel-Hezbollah in Lebanon, Israel-Hamas in Gaza, and Iran-US/Gulf maritime tensions — indicates a high risk of broader regional conflict. Israel's targeted killing of a senior Radwan commander and strikes on Hezbollah infrastructure signal intent to degrade capabilities despite ceasefire understandings. Iran's missile launches toward the Strait of Hormuz and Trump's claims of degraded Iranian capabilities create a volatile deterrence environment. The US shift to economic and maritime pressure on Iranian financial networks suggests a strategy of strangulation that could provoke asymmetric retaliation. Qatar's role as intermediary for captured pilots and Oman's involvement in new shipping routes highlight Gulf states' delicate balancing act.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states are actively engaging in de-escalation efforts: Qatar facilitating pilot remains handover, Oman negotiating new maritime routes with Iran, and Pakistan relaying messages. However, the UAE reports US plans for intensified pressure on Iranian financial networks, which may undermine diplomatic channels. Lebanese civilians in the south face ongoing artillery and airstrikes, while northern Israeli communities are warned of overnight explosions. Iranian domestic rhetoric emphasizes resilience with 168 consecutive nights of pro-regime rallies, but Trump's claims of 82% missile production reduction, if accurate, significantly alter the strategic calculus.
sections.intelligence_notes: The capture of three Iranian pilots by Qatar in March and their prolonged detention without consular access suggests Qatar may be leveraging them in broader negotiations. Iran's new submarine reveal indicates continued investment in asymmetric naval capabilities despite war pressures. The high strike count on Tehran's District 4 (298 hits) implies Israeli intelligence penetration and targeting of IRGC or leadership facilities. The relocation of US Navy logistics from Bahrain to Diego Garcia confirms significant operational disruption from Iranian attacks. The Islamabad agreement's 60-day dialogue window remains a potential off-ramp, but Araghchi's insistence on distinguishing it from a ceasefire suggests Iran seeks substantive sanctions relief before de-escalation.
